olga: Quick brain-dump: prototyped a tiny "tiered coalescer" to avoid warmup storms. Wanted to capture tradeoffs here.

olga: Core idea: keep two logical lanes in the coalescer - FAST (short deadlines, no warmup) and WARM (longer deadlines, may emit warmup hints). Separate budgets to prevent WARM from stomping FAST.

mike: Budget enforcement?

olga: Per-node warmup_byte_budget and per-tenant warmup_credit. When WARM emits a hint it consumes credits; if credits exhausted, WARM falls back to strict delivery (no hints).

sana: How do you prevent WARM from creating huge batches that block FAST?

olga: Two mechanisms: deadline-precedence (if any FAST item is near deadline it is prioritized) and an execution-time split: if a formed batch exceeds tenant_token_cap we split into micro-batches and prioritize the first micro-batch. Splits are recorded in telemetry.

tj: Thoughts on backpressure to clients?

olga: Small signal proto: {level:"soft"|"hard", suggested_prefetch:int, suggested_mode:"immediate"|"coalesce", ttl_ms:int}. SDK can act on it quickly. Keep ttl short (1s) to avoid stale signals.

mike: Telemetry minimums: batch_size_histogram, queue_wait_ms_by_lane, warmup_hints_accepted, warmup_bytes_allocated, split_count, backpressure_events.

sana: Rollout plan: land split-only behavior behind feature flag on staging (1% traffic), collect latencies and split counts for 24h, then enable hints in a separate opt-in pool with aggressive monitoring.

infra-bot: alert 2026-03-01T02:11Z - transient memory pressure observed on gpu-node-5 correlated with warmup fetches.

olga: Exactly why budgets are required. Also implement an automated rollback: if p95 latency up > 12% or node warmup bytes > 65% for 5m, disable hints for the pool.

mike: I'll add Prom rules and dashboard. Sana, want to own rollout doc?

sana: Yes, will write rollout + runbook.

tj: I'll put a tiny circuit-breaker in SDK to lower prefetch depth on soft backpressure.

olga: Thanks all. I'll open the PR with the shim and small unit tests. :thumbsup:

mike: LGTM.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: pushed tiered-coalescer split-only branch to staging at 6188890200.

olga: Posting PR link in the issue and scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow to walk through.

sana: Joining.

tj: Same.
